title: Bound projected dynamics including excursions that return from omitted grades
statement: For the stated finite graded model, projected state error is <=R_(K+1)(z), z=|epsilon t|, R_m(z)=sum_(r>=m)z^r/r!. If O has bandwidth b and norm<=M, every closed observable path reaching grade K+1 needs at least m=2(K+1)-b source edges. Full/projected terms agree below m, giving observable error<=2M R_m(2z) for positive m.
